June · Listen & Shadow 06

Say the Abstract — foot core vs trunk core in CAI
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · ONE LINE
👤 Friend
So, what's your paper about?
그래서 논문이 뭐에 대한 거예요?
paper — 논문
💬 June
In one line, we looked at whether foot core or trunk core training works better for people with chronic ankle instability.
한 줄로 말하면, 만성 발목 불안정 환자에게 발 코어 훈련과 몸통 코어 훈련 중 뭐가 더 효과적인지 봤어요.
in one line — 한 줄로 말하면 · foot core — 발 내재근 · trunk core — 몸통 코어 · chronic ankle instability (CAI) — 만성 발목 불안정
같은 패턴으로 — In one line, we compared two training methods for CAI patients. · In one line, we asked which core matters more for the ankle.
💬 June
It's about whether you should train the foot or the trunk for someone who keeps rolling their ankle, basically.
쉽게 말하면, 발목을 자꾸 삐는 사람한테 발을 단련시켜야 하는지, 몸통을 단련시켜야 하는지예요.
roll one's ankle — 발목을 삐다 · basically — 쉽게 말하면
같은 패턴으로 — It's about which muscles to strengthen first, basically. · It's about foot versus trunk, basically.
💬 June
We knew CAI patients have deficits in both — but no one had directly compared the two.
둘 다 결손이 있다는 건 알려져 있었는데, 아무도 직접 비교한 적이 없었어요.
deficit — 결손, 부족 · directly compare — 직접 비교하다
같은 패턴으로 — We knew both mattered — but no one had put them head to head. · Everyone assumed it; no one had tested it.
PART 2 · THREE MINUTES
👤 Friend
Can you walk me through it in three minutes?
3분 안에 설명해줄 수 있어요?
walk someone through ~ — 차근차근 설명하다
💬 June
The starting point was that CAI patients show problems in both foot core and trunk core.
출발점은 CAI 환자들이 발과 몸통 코어 양쪽에서 문제를 보인다는 거였어요.
starting point — 출발점 · show — 보이다, 나타내다
같은 패턴으로 — The starting point was a gap in the literature. · The starting point was what we kept seeing in clinic.
💬 June
What we did was randomize 21 participants into three groups — foot core, trunk core, and control.
저희가 한 건, 21명을 세 그룹으로 무작위 배정한 거예요 — 발 코어, 몸통 코어, 대조군.
randomize — 무작위 배정하다 · participant — 참가자 · control group — 대조군
같은 패턴으로 — What we did was run a randomized trial with three arms. · What we did was assign them at random, not by preference.
💬 June
We measured postural stability and muscle morphology.
자세 안정성과 근육 형태를 측정했어요.
postural stability — 자세 안정성 · muscle morphology — 근육 형태(크기·구조)
같은 패턴으로 — We measured balance and muscle size. · We tracked stability over the whole program.
💬 June
What we found was that both helped — but foot core training showed earlier improvements.
저희가 발견한 건, 둘 다 도움이 됐지만 발 코어 쪽이 더 빨리 좋아졌다는 거예요.
improvement — 개선 · earlier — 더 이른, 더 빠른
같은 패턴으로 — What we found was a clear difference in timing. · What we found was that foot core got there first.
💬 June
Postural stability and muscle morphology both changed sooner in the foot core group.
자세 안정성도, 근육 형태도 발 코어 그룹에서 먼저 변했어요.
sooner — 더 일찍
같은 패턴으로 — Both measures moved sooner in that group. · The foot core group changed first on every measure.
💬 June
Where people lose the thread is this: trunk training isn't bad — the foot is just faster.
여기서 사람들이 놓치는 부분은, 몸통 훈련이 나쁜 게 아니라 발이 더 빠르다는 거예요.
lose the thread — 흐름을 놓치다
같은 패턴으로 — Where people lose the thread is the word 'better' — it's about speed, not quality. · Where it gets tricky is that both worked.
PART 3 · SO WHAT
👤 Friend
Why does that matter — to someone outside your field?
그게 왜 중요해요? 전공자 아닌 사람한테요.
outside one's field — 전공 밖의
💬 June
It matters because it tells clinicians which intervention to prioritize.
이게 왜 중요하냐면, 임상가가 뭘 먼저 시킬지 정할 근거가 생기니까요.
clinician — 임상가(치료사·의사) · intervention — 훈련·치료 개입 · prioritize — 우선하다
같은 패턴으로 — It matters because time in rehab is limited. · It matters because patients don't have months to try both.
💬 June
The gap we're filling is the answer to 'which one first?'
저희가 채우려는 빈자리는, 둘 중 뭐부터인지에 대한 답이에요.
gap — 빈자리, 공백
같은 패턴으로 — The gap we're filling is a direct comparison. · The gap we're filling is the order of treatment.
💬 June
If this holds up, ankle rehab should start with the foot.
이게 맞다면, 발목 재활은 발부터 시작해야 해요.
hold up — (검증에서) 버티다 · rehab — 재활
같은 패턴으로 — If this holds up, the protocols need to change. · If this holds up, we'd test it on athletes next.
💬 June
For someone who keeps rolling their ankle, it means this: wake up the small muscles inside the foot first.
발목을 자꾸 삐는 사람한테는 이런 뜻이에요 — 발 안쪽의 작은 근육부터 깨워야 한다는 것.
wake up — 깨우다, 활성화하다
같은 패턴으로 — For a coach, it means foot work before core work. · For a patient, it means the boring foot exercises matter most.
